author: Tyler Haughn
title: Woman charged with forgery, theft after allegedly stealing over $50K from Indiana elementary school - NewsBreak
text:
By Tyler Haughn ,
6 hours ago
COLUMBUS, Ind. — Police have arrested a woman who is accused of stealing over $50,000 from an elementary school’s extracurricular funds in Bartholomew County.
The Columbus Police Department announced the arrest of 56-year-old Lilly Parker on multiple felony charges in connection with a theft investigation that was initiated in December 2025.
CPD said detectives assigned to the case soon identified Parker as the primary suspect after they uncovered evidence that she allegedly stole funds totalling over $50,000 while she was an employee at South Side Elementary School in the Bartholomew Consolidated School Corporation.
The case was then brought before the Indiana State Board of Accounts and the Bartholomew County Prosecutor’s Office, which filed the following formal charges against Parker:
• Theft ( Level 5 Felony )
• Forgery ( Level 6 Felony )
• Counterfeiting ( Level 6 Felony )
• Official Misconduct ( Level 6 Felony )
An arrest warrant was issued on Tuesday out of Bartholomew Circuit Court. Parker has since been taken into custody and is currently incarcerated at the Bartholomew County Jail.
